title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Thursday, 8 October 2026
description: A new Council of Europe-Microsoft AI accord and Mistral's release of its trillion-parameter Large 4 model, Woolworths' tripled fuel levy surcharge and the Victorian Greens' state-owned supermarket pledge, Queensland mayors' fight over disaster fund changes and the Savannah in the Round festival, and the Gold Coast Suns' looming Ben King deadline plus the Gold Coast 500's new Sound Track lineup. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
